text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creeks runs her race with an<n>air of
confidence.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But Tamamo Cross boastfully<n>informs her that she
has identified her<n>weakness.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Wondering what her weakness could<n>be, she
begins to prepare for the<n>spring Tenno Sho.
